# supposed

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:originSupposed`](gmeow-originSupposed.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/originSupposed>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/imagination`](../../slices/imagination.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Content entertained as a SUPPOSITION — taken on hypothetically for argument or exploration ([`gmeow:supposes`](../properties/gmeow-supposes.md)), not asserted. The hypothetical source, characteristically scoped to an imagined world ([`gmeow:imaginedWorld`](../properties/gmeow-imaginedWorld.md) → [logic:World](https://blackcatinformatics.ca/logic/World), by reference); distinct from believed content in that nothing is held true.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:ContentOrigin`](../classes/gmeow-ContentOrigin.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:originSupposed`](gmeow-originSupposed.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:ContentOrigin`](../classes/gmeow-ContentOrigin.md).
